relevance_rank_note: PhD thesis (Zulfiqar 2019, Marburg) with two isogenic APOE3/3 vs APOE4/4 human iPSC astrocyte pairs and endogenous APOE: the first endogenous-genotype human astrocyte endosome measurement in the set (Link 5). Early endosomes are larger in APOE4/4 astrocytes in both pairs; untreated isogenic neurons show no significant difference. Unreviewed, figure-read values.

quote: A4/4 and B4/4 astrocytes showed significantly larger EEA1-positive puncta compared to A3/3 and B3/3 astrocytes respectively (n= 3, * p < 0.05, *** p < 0.001, one-way ANOVA, Sidak’s multiple comparisons test).
system: Isogenic human iPSC-derived astrocytes, two pairs: A4/4 (iPSC from Coriell AG10984 lymphoblastoid cells, an APOE4/4 Alzheimer's patient) with A3/3 made from it by CRISPR/Cas9 editing; B3/3 and B4/4 (EBiSC BIONi010-C-2 and C-4). Endogenous APOE, terminally differentiated astrocyte monoculture, EEA1 immunostaining, confocal, Fiji MaxEntropy threshold, mean area of EEA1-positive puncta. One-way ANOVA with Sidak's test.
description: Early endosomes (EEA1-positive puncta) were larger in isogenic APOE4/4 human iPSC astrocytes than APOE3/3, pair A (AD-patient line and its edited APOE3/3 control): mean puncta area about 0.103 vs 0.083 µm², about 24% larger, p < 0.05.
summary: (APOE3/3 -> APOE4/4, isogenic human iPSC astrocytes, pair A) -> (larger EEA1 early endosomes)
human_check: Unreviewed PhD thesis (Philipps-Universität Marburg, 2019), so source type Other. Effect read from the rendered figure (bars at 2 to 3 significant figures). n = 3 per the legend, replicate unit (differentiations, wells or images) not stated. Searched for a peer-reviewed version: none found under the author's name in the ledger. Pair A's parent line is from an AD patient.
